ios.desc:
ServerGlance: SSH Server Monitor & Terminal

ServerGlance is a high-performance, developer-first server monitoring and SSH client built for Linux system administrators and DevOps engineers. Track your entire infrastructure in real-time through a sleek, terminal-inspired interface — no cloud middleman, ever.

KEY FEATURES

• Global Overview — Aggregate CPU, RAM, and network load across every server you manage, all in one dashboard.
• Real-Time Metrics — Deep-dive into disk health, uptime, and OS details for any node.
• Interactive SSH Terminal — Run commands on the go with a specialized mobile keyboard and custom quick-command snippets.
• Docker Container Control — Start, stop, and restart containers with a single tap, with confirmation prompts for critical actions.
• Instant Alerts — Get notified the moment CPU, RAM, or disk usage crosses your thresholds.
• Shareable Status Cards — Export a clean status card with live metrics to share anywhere.
• Biometric Security — Lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.
• Secure by Design — Standard SSH protocol. Your credentials stay encrypted on your device — never on our servers.

Whether you're managing a single VPS or a fleet of production servers, ServerGlance puts real infrastructure control in your pocket.
